metadata.description: Function-hook mods that ship beside the agent-scripts skills.

plugins.name: grok-bot-watch
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: watches a Grok Bot bot by UUID over a read-only CDP sidebar read and wakes this session when a new reply lands. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: session-assets
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: keeps what a session makes or prints (URLs, artifacts, files, images, commits) in a band above the prompt, per session, labelled with what produced it. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.
